tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Who MewToys is, where production is based, what the factory does, and which published pages cover manufacturing, sampling, testing and wholesale.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search published MewToys cat products by keyword, category or material. Returns SKU, title, category, summary, reference MOQ and the product page link.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Return the published specification, customization scope, packaging, sample review points and gallery for one SKU.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare two to four SKUs side by side and return only the specification fields where they differ.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the four published categories with their SKUs and category pages.

tools.name: get_customization_options
tools.description: Customization scope and guidance for one SKU, or the published options across the range when no SKU is given.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search published material on manufacturing, OEM/ODM, sampling, testing, wholesale, buyer guides, FAQ, glossary and comparisons. Product pages are excluded; use search_products for those.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Return the full text of one published page or guide, using an id from search_knowledge or its path.

tools.name: get_quote_link
tools.description: Return the contact page link with SKUs and inquiry intent prefilled. Prices are not published; the written quotation follows the buyer’s request.
